levels.surface: عبد الله بنالحسين بن زيد بن علي بن الحسين بن علي بن أبي طالب

notes: Opening «حدثنا أبي» : the compiler's own father is written as a bare relation, with no name in the text
«أبيه», «آبائه» are bare relations; the Imam Ali after «عن» is a narrator; the Prophet's words are the end of the chain
The 10-22 prefix and the blessings are not part of any surface
